notes:
Agent recommendation, review and execution loop Phase 1–3 application release. Adds tenant/site/environment-scoped requests and immutable threads; four source references; bounded real-AI preparation; two distinct user confirmations; outbound machine identity, read-only preparations, execution authorization and receipts; SEO/internal-link/module-publication/media actions; independent restoration requests; real manual delivery/review; and durable immediate checks plus fixed observation windows. This application release does not itself approve a production website content action, satisfy a human manual exercise, deploy the separate WordPress runner, or demonstrate business lift. Those remain explicit acceptance gates in docs/219 and docs/250.

Database: additive migrations 030–047 on top of production 029. Never downgrade or restore an old whole database during application rollback. The actual encrypted production 029 backup was restored into an internal PostgreSQL16 copy: first/repeated migrations preserved every row of 33 original business tables; actual v0.2.22 and candidate APIs started on schema047. Startup removed four exactly expired task snapshots via unchanged seven-day retention; the strict original mismatch and independent complete-row-hash explanation are retained in p3-saas-production-029-rehearsal-r2.json and p3-saas-production-029-retention-readback-r1.json. Existing organization/account/site/GSC/GA4 data must be retained.

Rollback target: v0.2.22 application images only, with current retention-capable backup and cleanup images independently pinned by immutable RepoDigest. Before rollback stop outbound execution claims, inspect and preserve all in-flight/unknown operations, and retain authorizations, receipts and evidence; never replay unknown writes. The follow-up worker stops when the target has no entrypoint, while queued observations remain durable. Agent requests become unavailable in the old UI/API and must remain in the database for re-upgrade. This does not roll back any website content change; that requires its own approved restoration request. Permanent attachment metadata remains; temporary attachment bytes/derived content and private preview HTML are excluded from archives. Restored files are missing and must be uploaded/generated again; restore with the normal migrator/app-role grants and run cleanup before reopening.

Bootstrap: independently pins AGENT_BACKUP_IMAGE and AGENT_ATTACHMENT_CLEANUP_IMAGE before migration, waits for the safe backup service, carries those verified service definitions and pins through old-control-file restoration, and never treats Docker failure as missing capability. Refuses pre-retention updater protocol before migration because old failure recovery would restart an unsafe backup service. For v0.2.22 installations first download/check the public bootstrap SHA256SUMS and install its verified update.sh, then use sudo b2b-platform update v0.2.23; do not set the internal protocol flag manually. Explicit rollback requires the exact rollbackCompatibleFrom array member. Fresh installs also start/health-check agent-followup and browser-audit-egress.

Validation: full API suite 1962 passed/160 skipped; production029 restoration and old-image compatibility; 23 executable bootstrap checks including the actual v0.2.22 Compose fixture; five real encrypted backup/restore/cleanup checks using isolated synthetic schema047 data with old API active. The retention test uses the previously built candidate plus the exact recompiled backup module and records that limitation; CI must build and publish the final source images. Production and final digest/provenance/actual login/BFF/machine-boundary acceptance are recorded only after deployment in docs/250 and its successor evidence.
